title: The Essence of Christian Mysticism (recorded retreat, DVD set)
description: The annual retreat she gave for about thirty years (for practising Christian contemplatives who had read her first three books), recorded once so that it could be distributed as a DVD set, after which she stopped giving it live. She regarded it as a prerequisite for reading The Real Christ. Nine hours of talks in four files plus handouts. Sold through the friends-run blog; masters held by Bernadette's Friends (her student circle) / her estate. One of only two authorized recordings of her; the blog states that no video or audio of her on YouTube or elsewhere is authorized.

title: A Passage Through Self (recorded talk, 2-DVD set)
description: The 'circles course' talk she gave around the country after her first books: circle diagrams mapping ego-self to True Self in union with God, the dark night of the spirit, the unitive state, the 'marketplace' stage and the final falling away of self. A Shalom Place reviewer (Derek) who bought the two-DVD set from her website reports it was originally recorded in 1994 on VHS and has audible hiss. Listed as 2.5 hours on the blog, 3 hours by the reviewer. Prerequisite viewing for the retreat. Masters with Bernadette's Friends.

title: The Passion of Grace: New Dimensions Radio program 2276 with Bernadette Roberts
format: radio interview; MP3 download and audiobook listing
description: Public-radio interview, host Michael Toms, interview date 1 August 1991, program number 2276. She discusses the nature of self and its relation to God, grace, the spiritual value of suffering, the Virgin Mary and prayer. Sold as MP3 by New Dimensions Foundation (who hold the master) and distributed as a 58-minute unabridged audiobook on Google Play, Barnes & Noble and Everand. The only broadcast interview of her found.

title: Bernadette Roberts on why Christ is not in Christianity
description: YouTube id eObqnWn-ppQ. Described in its listing as a 41-minute excerpt from the DVD set The Essence of Christian Mysticism. Linked as the 'full video' by the Dancing Paradox podcast episode of the same name. Uploader channel not identified. Unauthorized per the friends-run blog.

title: Bernadette Roberts on being transformed into the Eucharist
description: YouTube id DsuWkp8TCgM. Same 'Bernadette Roberts on ...' upload series as eObqnWn-ppQ; an excerpt from the recorded retreat on the Eucharist.

title: Bernadette Roberts on the Eucharist
description: YouTube id irGOg8urye8. Excerpt from the recorded retreat, on the Eucharist. Same series.

title: Bernadette Roberts (untitled upload)

title: Bernadette Roberts - A Path to No-Self: Life at The Center
description: YouTube id eD7Z2Z58Kbg. Title suggests a reading from or presentation of The Path to No-Self; uploader and whether it is a narration or a DVD excerpt unverified.

title: The Path to No-Self: Beyond Unitive Consciousness with Bernadette Roberts (Shawn Ellison)
description: YouTube id Qoqfir9czOY. A presentation of her teaching by Shawn Ellison, not a recording of her (search summaries wrongly call it a conversation with her).

title: Journey From Self-Centered Consciousness to No-Self (Susanne Marie)
description: YouTube id xO7KKKaxBwo. Teacher Susanne Marie uses Bernadette Roberts's map of the journey to explain the move from self-centred consciousness to no-self. About her, not her voice.

title: No Self ~ Bernadette Roberts ~ Christian Mystics (Wisdom of the Masters)
description: YouTube id xJcnEBoKEWs; also on Spotify as episode 4sug9r5Aakjh6TQebVHPjS. Narrated selection of pointers on no-self drawn from her texts, read by Samaneri Jayasara (Viveka Hermitage) on the Wisdom of the Masters channel. Not her voice.

title: Dancing Paradox ep. 156: Bernadette Roberts | The Path To No Self
description: Alex Hickman's Dancing Paradox podcast (Apple id 1326902050; also Podbean, podtail, tunein); a 14-minute excerpt of Bernadette Roberts speaking about the experience of no-self, lifted from the retreat recordings and linked to an 'original video' on YouTube.

title: Dancing Paradox: Bernadette Roberts | Why Christ Is Not In Christianity
description: Dancing Paradox episode, 'a passage by Bernadette Roberts', excerpting the retreat recording; links youtu.be/eObqnWn-ppQ as the full video. Same release date as ep. 156.

title: Bernadette Roberts on How it Works - diving into the Unmanifested (Journals of Spiritual Discovery, spiritualteachers.org)
description: Reading and discussion of her essay 'How it Works' (unmanifested, manifesting, manifested) from The Experience of No-Self, on the spiritualteachers.org podcast Journals of Spiritual Discovery (Apple id 1166016137, episode 1000521944436, 2021). The host notes she insisted on being read as a Christian writer. Not her voice.

title: L'esperienza del non-sé: un viaggio contemplativo di Bernadette Roberts (ai Podcast)
description: Italian AI-generated podcast summary of The Experience of No-Self on Spotify.

title: Read What Is Self? ... Book Overview (Spotify AI summary)
description: Spam-style AI 'book overview' episode on What Is Self?. Listed for completeness.

title: Audible author page: Bernadette Roberts (B001HCXWTQ)
description: Audible author page under the same Amazon author id as her books. The only audio title traceable to it is the New Dimensions 'Passion of Grace' program; no narrated edition of any book was found. Better World Books advertises an AudiobooksNow option for The Experience of No-Self and The Path to No-Self but with empty placeholder fields; Everand's '9 hours' for What Is Self? is an ebook reading-time estimate.

title: Sat Sangha Salon: downloadable 'books and audios of Bernadette Roberts'
description: The Sat Sangha Salon teacher page says it offers downloadable books and audios of Bernadette Roberts; which audio files, and whether they are the DVD soundtrack, is unverified.
